CREATE materialized view CUSTOMER_SUMMARY 
WITH (DISTRIBUTION=HASH(ORGKEY)) 
--	CREATE VIEW EDS.CUSTOMER_SUMMARY
AS
SELECT DATE_DIM.FULLDATE
	, CUST.ORGKEY
	, TRB.[TRB PURE CASA (M)]
	, TRB.[TRB PURE CASA (M&J)]
	, TRB.[TRB PURE CASA (ALL)]
	, TRB.[TRB ALL DEP (M)]
	, TRB.[TRB ALL DEP (M&J)]
	, TRE.LNS_ACCT_CNT
	, CCD.CCD_ACCT_CNT
	, TRU.TRU_ACCT_CNT
	, TRY.TRY_ACCT_CNT
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
	ON DATE_DIM.FULLDATE BETWEEN CUST.SCD_START_DATE AND CUST.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_TRB_SUMMARY TRB
	ON DATE_DIM.FULLDATE = TRB.AS_OF_DATE
	AND CUST.ORGKEY = TRB.ORGKEY
LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_TRE_SUMMARY TRE
	ON DATE_DIM.FULLDATE = TRE.AS_OF_DATE
	AND CUST.ORGKEY = TRE.ORGKEY
LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_CCD_SUMMARY CCD
	ON DATE_DIM.FULLDATE = CCD.AS_OF_DATE
	AND CUST.ORGKEY = CCD.CUSTOMER_ID
LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_TRU_SUMMARY TRU
	ON DATE_DIM.FULLDATE = TRU.AS_OF_DATE
	AND CUST.ORGKEY = TRU.CUSTOMER_ID
LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_TRY_SUMMARY TRY
	ON DATE_DIM.FULLDATE = TRY.AS_OF_DATE
	AND CUST.ORGKEY = TRY.CUSTOMER_ID	
WHERE (DATE_DIM.FULLDATE BETWEEN DATEADD (month , -13 , CAST(SYSDATETIME () AS DATE) ) AND CAST(SYSDATETIME () AS DATE)
	AND MONTH_END = 'Y')
	OR (
			DATE_DIM.FULLDATE = (
									SELECT MIN(BUSINESS_DATE)
									FROM (
											SELECT DEPOSITS_DATE BUSINESS_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL
											UNION
											SELECT LOANS_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL
											UNION
											SELECT CCD_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL
											UNION
											SELECT TRU_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL
											UNION
											SELECT TRY_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL
										)a
										
								)
		)
				
CREATE materialized  view EDS.CUSTOMER_TRE_SUMMARY 
WITH (DISTRIBUTION=HASH(ORGKEY)) 

--CREATE VIEW EDS.CUSTOMER_TRE_SUMMARY
AS
SELECT AS_OF_DATE
	, GAM_BANK_ID	
	, ORGKEY 
	, SUM(
			CASE 
				WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'M' THEN 
					CASE 
						WHEN APPLICATION = 'CLA' THEN RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP 
						ELSE 0 
					END 
				ELSE 0 
			END
		) AS [TRB CLA (M)]
	, SUM(
			CASE 
				WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J') THEN 
					CASE 
						WHEN APPLICATION = 'CLA' THEN RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP 
						ELSE 0 
					END 
				ELSE 0 
			END
		) AS [TRB CLA (M&J)]
	, SUM(
			CASE 
				WHEN APPLICATION = 'CLA' THEN RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP 
				ELSE 0 
			END 
		) AS [TRB CLA (ALL)]
--	**********		
	, SUM(
			CASE 
				WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'M' THEN 
					CASE 
						WHEN APPLICATION = 'LAA' THEN RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP 
						ELSE 0 
					END 
				ELSE 0 
			END
		) AS [TRB LAA (M)]
	, SUM(
			CASE 
				WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J') THEN 
					CASE 
						WHEN APPLICATION = 'LAA' THEN RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP 
						ELSE 0 
					END 
				ELSE 0 
			END
		) AS [TRB LAA (M&J)]
	, SUM(
			CASE 
				WHEN APPLICATION = 'LAA' THEN RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP 
				ELSE 0 
			END 
		) AS [TRB LAA (ALL)]
	, COUNT(*) AS LNS_ACCT_CNT

FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_TRE_DETAIL
--	WHERE AS_OF_DATE IN (SELECT LOANS_DATE FROM EDS.EDS_CTL)
GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE
	, GAM_BANK_ID	
	, ORGKEY;


--CREATE materialized  view EDS.CUSTOMER_TRE_DETAIL 
--WITH (DISTRIBUTION=HASH(ORGKEY)) 
CREATE VIEW EDS.CUSTOMER_TRE_DETAIL WITH SCHEMABINDING AS
SELECT * FROM EDS.DATE_DIM

SELECT A.AS_OF_DATE 
	, ECD.ORGKEY
	, ELF.GAM_BANK_ID	
	, EBD.REGION AS REGION
	, EBD.AREA AS AREA
	, EBD.SOL_DESC AS BRANCH_NAME
	, ELF.GAM_ACID	
--	, ELF.GAM_FORACID
--	, ECD.ORGKEY 
	, ELF.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE 
	, EDP.PRODUCT_GROUP
	, EDP.APPLICATION
	, A.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE	
--	, ELF.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP 
	, ELF.RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
	, ELF.BILLED_AMOUNT_PHP
	, ELF.CREDIT_LIMIT_PHP
FROM EDS.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN A

LEFT JOIN EDS.LOAN_FACT ELF
	ON A.AS_OF_DATE = ELF.AS_OF_DATE
	AND A.ACID = ELF.GAM_ACID
	AND A.BANK_ID = ELF.GAM_BANK_ID
	
LEFT JOIN EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING EDP
	ON ELF.GAM_SCHM_CODE = EDP.PRODUCT_TYPE
	AND ELF.GAM_BANK_ID = EDP.BANK_CODE
	AND ELF.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN EDP.SCD_START_DATE AND EDP.SCD_END_DATE

LEFT JOIN EDS.BRANCH_DIM EBD
    ON ELF.SOL_ID = EBD.SOL_ID
    AND ELF.GAM_BANK_ID = EBD.BANK_ID
    AND A.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN EBD.SCD_START_DATE AND EBD.SCD_END_DATE
	
LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
	ON A.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
	AND A.CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID
	AND A.BANK_ID = ECD.BANK_ID
	
LEFT JOIN EDS.BRANCH_DIM D
	ON ELF.SOL_ID = D.SOL_ID
	AND ELF.GAM_BANK_ID = D.BANK_ID
	
WHERE A.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
	AND A.DEL_FLG = 'N'
	AND ELF.LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C'
	AND A.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
	AND ELF.GAM_ACID IS NOT NULL;

--	AND (LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C' AND LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS IS NOT NULL)
